players.product: High-k ALD precursor materials for advanced DRAM; photoacid generators and metallic compounds for EUV / advanced photoresists

quarterly_data.quarter: ADEKA results briefing: Briefings on FY2026 First Quarter Results (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor Materials outlook for FY2026 (year ending March 2027): the company expects demand for advanced memory to trend upward on AI-related investment, demand for advanced materials to rise with DRAM miniaturization and wider EUV use, and the switch from existing production lines to advanced products to gain momentum; it notes mass production of N2-generation logic ICs will begin. Initiatives: increase sales of ALD materials for advanced DRAM, accelerate development of ALD materials for advanced logic and EUV resist materials, and increase sales of metallic compounds used in metal oxide resist (MOR) with investment in production equipment. Segment forecast revised up.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor Materials FY2026 forecast: net sales 43.3 billion yen (H1 21.7, H2 21.6; +2.3 vs previous), operating profit 10.0 billion yen (+1.0 vs previous)

quarterly_data.quarter: ADEKA results briefing: Briefings on FY2026 First Quarter Results (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: expanding photoacid generator manufacturing lines for advanced photoresists at the ADEKA Chiba Plant to approximately twice their previous size, with operation scheduled to commence in September 2028; the company says that with demand growing faster than expected the photoacid generator capacity expansion was brought forward by about two years, building a mass production system ahead of full-scale demand for A10-generation products.
quarterly_data.figure: Investment approx. 1 billion yen; capacity approx. twofold; start-up September 2028
